Plausibility checks and summaries of a multistate model

Source: R/state.R
wgh_msm_check.Rd

wgh_msm_check() flags baseline intensities that imply implausibly short stays. The canalization study (Ho 2026, manuscript under review) met a reference-profile intensity of 27 per year that broke the standard errors. wgh_msm_summary() returns intensities, one-year transition probabilities, mean sojourn times and hazard ratios. wgh_msm_prevalence() compares observed and expected state prevalence.

Usage

wgh_msm_check(object, max_rate = 5)

wgh_msm_summary(object, t = 1)

wgh_msm_prevalence(object, times = NULL)

Arguments

object

A wgh_msm object.

max_rate

Largest plausible intensity per year.

t

Time horizon (years) for transition probabilities.

times

Times for the prevalence comparison.

Value

Tibbles.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("msm", quietly = TRUE)) {
  st <- wgh_states(growdat2_mini[growdat2_mini$age >= 5, ])
  ms <- wgh_msm(wgh_msm_data(st), covariates = "sex")
  wgh_msm_check(ms)
  s <- wgh_msm_summary(ms, t = 1)
  s$hazard_ratios
  wgh_msm_prevalence(ms)
}
